newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up, recover from panic.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up, recover from panic.

text.p: Dhaka stocks recovered from a persistent slump with panic easing after the government and bourse authorities announced measures on Monday to bring back investors' confidence, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index closed 1.1 points or 0.04 percent up at 2,619.4 on a turnover of 45.8 million taka. Of 97 issues, 66 lost, 39 gained and two unchanged.

Brokers said gains by some weighted scrips helped index to rise marginally. "Mostly institutions were active. But we hope retail investors will return soon," said one broker. Bangladesh Tobacco rose 10 tk to 250 and Monno Ceramic lost 66 to 1,269.
